DETAILS: Welcome to Side Beach, a stunning home in the picturesque Dune Allen community along the Emerald Coast. With breathtaking Gulf views, 5 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and 2,652 square feet of living space, this retreat ensures comfort and luxury for up to 21 guests. It's the perfect setting for a memorable Gulf getawayâ€”a short 2-minute drive from the beachâ€”with a private pool, ping-pong table, and giant tic-tac-toe board.

Experience the ultimate outdoor retreat at this stunning 3-story stilted home along the Emerald Coast. The ground floor features a covered patio with plush seating and 2 TVs, a kidney-shaped pool with sun loungers, outdoor shower, and fun games like ping-pong, darts, and tic-tac-toe. An outdoor grill makes alfresco dining fun and easy.

Details exude sophistication throughout the first floor of this coastal retreat. The sleek white kitchen features high-end appliances, marble countertops, and a spacious island with seating for 5. Adjoining the kitchen is a quaint wet bar with a wine cooler and coffee maker. The well-lit dining area offers a stylish mix of bench and chair seating, comfortably accommodating 10-13 guests at a time. The cozy living area with calming touches of blue complements the Gulf views. Warm hardwood floors and a 65" TV create the perfect setting for movie nights at home. Families will appreciate the versatile bunk room on this floor, featuring a twin-over-king bed. The cool coastal breeze and outdoor furnishings beckon guests to the sun-filled deck through French doorsâ€”total paradise!

The second floor has 3 comfy bedroomsâ€”2 guest bedrooms with a king and queen bed and 1 primary bedroom with a king bed, private bath with a soaking tub, cozy TV area, and breathtaking balcony views.

Head to the third floor, where a bunk room with 3 full-over-full beds and a private bathroom are complemented by a convenient wet bar with a mini fridge. A top-floor balcony offers unobstructed panoramic views of the Gulf!

Embrace the coastal lifestyle with unparalleled leisure at Side Beach! With on-site parking for 3 vehiclesâ€”plus 5 adult bikes and a 6-passenger golf cartâ€”itâ€™s easy to explore the area. For Dune Allen Beach Access, take Breeze Drive north to Sunset Avenue and then turn right. Turn right again onto 30A, and the beach will be visible from Hilltop Drive. Book this fantastic Florida property today!

description:
Located near the beach, this vacation home is in Dune Allen Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. While the natural beauty of Santa Rosa Beach and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sirens at the Beach and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Take an opportunity to explore the area for water adventures such as swimming.
